title: Introduce artifact chainlink signing + shadow index for Helm/Terraform rollback automation
author: Samantha Ortiz
description:
Background: Private deployments require deterministic, auditable release artifacts for installer, Helm charts and Terraform modules. Current release manifests are split across multiple indexes which makes atomic rollbacks and cross-artifact provenance brittle. This PR introduces an artifact "chainlink" index and a lightweight "shadow" TUF index that links signed artifact records across Helm charts, installer bundles, and terraform modules to enable single-command rollback and deterministic verification.

What this PR does: 1) Adds a chainlink manifest generator that consumes per-artifact provenance (cosign/attest) and emits a signed chain entry that references all related artifact digests and build metadata. 2) Introduces a shadow TUF index stored alongside the main release index; the shadow index is minimal (only pointers and chainlink entries) used by the private-installer to compute atomic rollbacks without fetching full bundles. 3) Extends the release pipeline step (release/orchestrator) to: a) stamp chainlinks using cosign with KMS-backed key rotation policy, b) publish shadow index shards keyed by region and channel, c) emit per-release rollback recipe JSON that the private-installer and helm upgrader consume. 4) Adds Terraform module anchors: small signed metadata files that tie a module version to a chainlink entry so infra changes are included in the same rollback set. 5) Helm chart metadata augmentation: chart labels now include chainlink-id and build-range to allow chart controllers to decide safe downgrades.

Why: This addresses several incidents where partial artifact rotation left clusters with incompatible combos (installer vs chart). By creating a first-class chainlink and shadow index we can verify families of artifacts and perform atomic rollbacks across heterogeneous artifacts.

Testing & validation: Unit tests for chainlink generation and signature validation included. Integration test in pipeline simulates publish + rollback with a two-region shadow shard test (us-west-2, eu-central-1). Added a smoke test in the private-installer e2e suite that applies a rollback recipe against a local kind cluster running the on-prem chart + terraform plan validation. CI: release/orchestrator integration pipeline and cosign signing flow were exercised; all stages passed in the run attached to this PR.

Migration notes: Older releases without chainlink entries continue to be served from the legacy index; the release orchestrator emits a compatibility shim for releases < 2024-11. Operators are encouraged to run the 'releasectl migrate-shadow --dry-run' job to audit their indices before turning on automatic rollback enforcement.

Rollback flow (operator-facing): 1) releasectl get-rollback <release-id> -> returns rollback recipe with chainlink entries and pinned artifact digests. 2) private-installer apply-rollback <recipe> -> validates signatures against KMS public keys, downloads minimal shadow shards, and performs staged rollbacks (helm, terraform, installer images) with checkpoints. 3) On failure, the system will attempt a fail-forward to safe baseline defined in the recipe.

Security & keys: Uses cosign for signing; keys are stored in KMS with rotation policies. The signing step includes an attest SLSA-style predicate containing builder image, CI-run id, and image provenance. We added a new RBAC check in release/orchestrator so only users in release-admins can publish chainlinks.

Related: SUP-873 (customer incident that highlighted partial-release inconsistency), ENG-2143 (chainlink design doc), ENG-2199 (private-installer rollback API).

Notes for reviewers: focus on the chainlink schema, cosign invocation boundaries, and shadow index shard format. The shadow shard contract is deliberately minimal; any backward-incompatible deviation must be coordinated with infra teams.

Checklist: - [x] Unit tests added - [x] Integration pipeline updated - [x] Docs snippets in release/README updated - [x] Migration job added

review_comments: Derek Wu: The chainlink schema looks good; can we compress the predicate to avoid DB bloat? Suggest moving non-essential fields to an optional 'metadata' blob.
Samantha Ortiz: Good call, compressed predicates into 'metadata_blob' and added gzip+base64 helper in release/orchestrator.
Priya Nair: Need to ensure the KMS key rotation won't break old signatures during key rollover window. Can we include key-id history in the recipe?
Samantha Ortiz: Added key history array to the recipe and backwards-compat shim for legacy index consumers.
Liam Carter: Integration test timing is flaky in CI (timeout at 3m). Increase timeout and add retries for cosign fetches.
Samantha Ortiz: Increased timeout to 10m and added exponential backoff around cosign remote checks. CI rerun passed.
release_notes: Adds chainlink artifact manifest and shadow TUF index to enable atomic cross-artifact rollbacks for private deployments; introduces terraform anchors and helm metadata for coordinated rollbacks. Includes migration helper and operator rollback recipe.
